title: jarava chrysophylla var. cordillerarum
intro: Jarava chrysophylla var. cordillerarum, commonly known as the Cordillera jarava, is a plant species within the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include aiding in the management of respiratory issues, inflammation, and fever. The health benefits of the Cordillera jarava plant are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified in various studies on the plant's extracts.
